query: SELECT FLOOR(cmt.receivable_id / 1000000) as range_m, COUNT(*) as cnt, SUM(cmt.ticked) as ticked_cnt FROM collection_manual_ticks cmt LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = cmt.receivable_id WHERE ar.id IS NULL GROUP BY range_m ORDER BY range_m;
